description: Software Factory enforcement for the GitHub Copilot CLI: agents propose, the CLI and these hooks decide. Native Copilot format (camelCase events, flat outputs); no matchers — each script filters by the normalised tool name. Each command starts with H=<plugin>:<hook>, so a timeout warning names the hook. Every launcher ends in exit 0: if node is missing, too old or crashes, the hooks are off with a warning on stderr instead of denying every tool (a deny is JSON on stdout).

sessionStart.bash: H=factory:session; R=$PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -n "$R" ] || R=$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -n "$R" ] || R=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { echo "[$H] hook script $R/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped" >&2; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[$H] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2; exit 0; }; node "$R/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart || echo "[$H] hook failed (exit $?); allowed" >&2; exit 0
sessionStart.powershell: $h='factory:session'; $r=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook script $r/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped"); exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)"); exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE); allowed") }; exit 0
